evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the acquire path creates the marker with O_CREAT|O_EXCL (lines 400-401) and fsyncs only the token file (line 412); it never fsyncs the marker's parent directory. A power loss can therefore lose the marker's directory entry even after the token file was fsynced, defeating the admission hold. This is an implementation gap in the existing durable-admission behavior, not merely a request to enlarge protection scope. The release-path half of the finding is consistent with the same omission, but the acquire path alone establishes the defect.
